attributes.title: NPACE 2027 Chicago: The Great APP Exchange & Expo
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: NPACE's Chicago conference runs August 16 to 19, 2027, at the InterContinental hotel and is paired with NPACE's APP Connect Expo, which brings together employers, schools, technology vendors and pharmacology updates. NPACE lists 18+ CE/CME credits for the conference itself. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists full conference registration at $1,250 (the APP Connect Expo alone is $99); staying three or more nights at the conference hotel takes $150 off, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.
